newsitem.title: INDIA: Six injured in explosions in New Delhi - police.
newsitem.headline: Six injured in explosions in New Delhi - police.

text.p: At least six people were wounded on Tuesday in three explosions in the Indian capital's old quarter, police said.
"Six or seven people were injured," a police spokesman told Reuters by telephone. "There were three explosions, one after the other. We don't know if they were bombs," he said.
He said the explosions occurred near a clock tower in Old Delhi's Subzi Mandi vegetable market, and near two cinema halls located in the same neighbourhood.
